response.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804;

assumptions.assumption: The database is SQLite-style: integer division would truncate, so Bytes is cast to REAL to get a decimal ratio. NULL Bytes rows are dropped by the > filter.

"Ignore missing values" also covers Milliseconds = 0, where the ratio is undefined. Those rows are excluded from the bytes-per-millisecond average only, via NULLIF, and still count toward the UnitPrice average.

alternatives.interpretation: Ratio of totals instead of an average of per-track ratios: total bytes divided by total milliseconds across the qualifying tracks.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, SUM(CAST(Bytes AS REAL)) / NULLIF(SUM(Milliseconds), 0) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804;
